Chapter 6950: Lost Relationship

Chapter 6950: Lost Relationship

“May I ask for your title, Dao Brother?” Heaven’s Equal couldn’t help but bow to greet Li Qiye.

“Li Qiye.” Li Qiye said flatly.

“Li Qiye.” Listeners have never heard of this name before.

Such a magical existence shouldn’t be unknown in Heavenrealm. A cultivator versed in fortune-telling had peered into the high heaven before. Alas, he found nothing about Li Qiye’s roots.

Thus, how did such a being become so powerful?

“Li Qiye?” Apex took a deep breath and asked: “You have visited my humble abode before.”

“Yes, but they said you weren’t there.” Li Qiye smiled.

Various thoughts and emotions appeared in Apex’s mind as he realized something. Many stared at him, wondering about the past.

He couldn’t tell them and swallowed the truth. This happened long, long ago.

One day, a person named Li Qiye brought a group of disciples to his sect, wanting to discuss a matter. However, he didn’t bother to meet them.

After all, even immortals weren’t qualified to meet him. Why would he make an exception to come out of hibernation for an unknown junior? He never gave this matter a second thought.

Later on, his disciples told him that many immortals from Guardian Alliance were part of the group that had visited them.

He also didn’t care then since this was all in the past. Surely they couldn’t have held a grudge against his branch.

As Guardian grew stronger, everything changed dramatically. He finally cared because building a relationship with Guardian Alliance became more complicated due to this forgotten past. The name, Li Qiye, stuck with him from then on.

As Apex stood in a daze, Li Qiye asked Breaker: “Does your branch have any other capable immortals?”

Breaker was the only one left now; the others were forced into submission. Unfortunately, he had zero confidence since he couldn’t assess Li Qiye’s true potential.

“I have no feud against you.” He said, no longer looking like his imperious self.

“Yes.” Li Qiye said.

“If that’s the case, then there is no need for you to destroy us. Kill those eight as punishment and let me know if there is anything else I can do.” Breaker said.

Others thought Breaker was only one step away from kneeling and begging for mercy. No progenitor could forgive the feud of slain disciples. However, he was offering his members to Li Qiye.

“Immortals can’t be judged by conventional wisdom.” One spectator gave him an excuse.

After all, immortals cared about themselves the most. Others were ephemeral in their eyes.

Those in the crowd wondered if they would do the same thing in his position. Would they fight to the bitter end or acquiesce to live?

Hesitation surfaced instead of a clear answer. They had never experienced such an overwhelming loss before. The fear of death was the main motivator, the reason why many fell to the darkness.

Thus, some thought Breaker’s choice was logical and correct.
